doc: A castle's part (design/planner.md, Castles), as a config entry: the keep, a great hall, a chapel, a range of barracks, stables, a kitchen, or storehouses, or a tower, with its stone, roof, and what it shows.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How it is built: a keep (a great tower with corner turrets), a hall (a tall stone hall with buttresses and tall windows), a chapel (a small church with a bellcote), a range (a long low building against a wall: barracks, stables, a kitchen, storehouses), or a tower (round, standing on its own).

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Its usual lot: small (rect6x5), medium (rect8x6), large (rect10x7), or keep (rect8x8).

fields.name: roof
fields.doc: What covers it: none (a flat, crenellated top), slate, lead, tile, or thatch.

fields.name: stories
fields.doc: Storeys (1 to 5; a keep's are taller).

fields.name: windows
fields.doc: Its windows: arrow slits, arched windows, or tall traceried ones.

fields.name: doors
fields.doc: Its doors: one door up steps, an arch, or a row of stable doors.
